spans.text: In the Griffin Command Room.
Something on your mind?
...No, it's nothing.
I was just thinking about what Havier wants us to do next.
It seems you also feel the requests he's made don't match up to the help he's given.
I can't be sure, but one thing I've learned after going through so much...
...is that there's no such thing as being too cautious.
I would also advise against placing too much trust in him.
For all we know, you might be nothing more than a valuable tool in his eyes.
However righteous and earnest he may have sounded earlier, the fact is that we know too little about the big picture.
You should take advantage of this opportunity to trade the intel we obtain for genuinely useful things.
Got it.
Oh yes, are you serious about going on missions with the AR Team?
There's no simpler or better way to collect information than directly interfacing with Paradeus.
Or are you worried that I'll vanish without saying a word after leaving the base?
I couldn't stop you if you truly wanted to go.
However, if you did that, you wouldn't have anyone to help you look for M4.
But of course.
What else do you dislike about the arrangement?
How shall I put this...? You say there's no need to worry about those Dolls.
But in my experience, whenever one of their members takes a temporary leave of absence...
The rest of the AR Team usually falls into depression.
You're worried RO and the others won't be able to get over M4's departure?
It's just a possibility.
We both know how much M4 means to the AR Team.
I'm more like them, compared to normal Dolls.
I will take good care of them in place of their original team leader.
Please don't say that in front of them...
I was just kidding. I know what I ought to do.
There's one more thing, actually.
Dandelion, put this coat on.
Isn't this your uniform coat?
You stand out too much as you are now.
You can make yourself invisible to Dolls, but that trick won't work on normal human beings.
With this, you'll look like a normal Griffin employee...more or less.
I don't have a spare one to give you at the moment, so just wear mine for the time being.
How considerate of you.
I can hear the sarcasm.
You'll just have to make do with this for now until Kalina gets some new clothes in.
There is a knock on the door. A shadow looms outside the frosted glass pane on the door.
Commander, may I come in?
Please, enter.
The door is kicked open with a loud bang.
Commander, look! RO looks super awesome now!
—Ehhhh?! What's Dandelion doing here?!
She will be going on missions with you.
—Ehhhhhhhhh! And why is she wearing your coat, Commander?
The Commander lent it to me for the time being. Envious?
Well...yes, yes I am!
I wanna wear it too! How come only Dandelion gets it?! It's not fair, Commander!
Would you mind not oohing and aahing at every little thing you see? We're here for a mission briefing, not to fool around.
Alright, alright, the Commander must have given it to Dandelion because he didn't want her to stand out too much.
So I gather all the Dolls present will be going on this mission?
Yes. We're short on personnel, so I'd like to group up all the Dolls who are still capable of independent action and send you on missions.
Then is SHE coming as well?
Everyone looks to the corner where AR-15 is pointing.
A shark mascot costume pressed up against the corner of the wall is looking towards us.
Woo wee! Someone finally noticed me! I was starting to wonder if I'd become a ghost!
Holy crap, it speaks!
I thought it was a new decoration in the Commander's office!
I thought it was just a prop myself... How careless of me, I didn't sense the presence of S.F.
I wish I hadn't noticed her.
For some reason, I have the feeling that talking to her is going to make things extremely complicated.
But shark mascots are cute!
They make me want to RIP THEM IN HALF!
Okay, okay, I got it!
Don't rip me in half!
I'm taking it off!
Good grief, none of you have any sense of humor. I curse you all to go bald!
Grawr!
Uwah!
After seeing the room liven up, the Commander turns to Dandelion.
Well? How do you think they're faring?
Better than I expected. At the very least they don't seem to be showing any signs of abnormal behavior.
But they're Dolls. You know what I mean.
...The way she keeps whispering into the Commander's ear is really annoying.
Commander, do we have a new mission?
Mm, yes.
Although the original plan was to rest and recuperate, something's come up.
I've got an assignment which I'd like you to complete.
You're too kind. This is our job.
Rather, I'm more concerned about...
RO glances at Architect.
What she is doing here.
Did she barge into your office by herself?
If need be, we can discipline her for you later on.
Ehhh?!
But the Commander called me up here!
She blended in so well that I forgot she existed for a moment...
How could you...
So, Dandelion is not the only one going on this mission with you.
Architect will also be coming along to assist you.
Dandelion is one thing...
But I can't accept HER as a new team member.
Grawr!
Uwaaaahh! She's doing it again!
Stay away from me!
Please hear me out.
RO, I should have sent you the mission plan.
Have you read it?
Yes, I have.
We are to proceed to a target destination and scout it out, then recover all suspicious items that we find.
This is a request from Havier.
He said you'll know what to bring back when you get there.
Sure is a vague mission.
In addition to his request, there's also a half-wrecked Sangvis plant in the region.
After completing Havier's request, head over there and investigate it.
So what does this have to do with HER?
That used to be the sector under Architect's command.
Also, we've received reports about it.
It seems someone spotted the Sangvis Ringleader "Gager" over there.
If conditions permit, use Architect as bait to capture Gager.
One of our current goals is to capture elite Sangvis Dolls; they have lots of information we need to extract from their neural clouds.
That's how it is. Sorry for the intrusion, dear members of the AR Team.
Just so happens I'm an irreplaceable, vital character this time round, so let's get along~
Well, if we only need her as bait, why don't we just chop her head off and bring it along?
S.F. Dolls work fine with just their heads, right?
Wait, what are you doing?!
Don't worry, it won't hurt a bit, it'll be over in a moment.
Stay away from meeeeeeeeeee!
Don't just stand there, Commander!
(Sighs) Alright, enough fooling around in the office. Run along and finish the mission. The sooner you finish, the sooner you can come back.
Yes, we'll head out right away.
Don't embarrass us in front of the Commander. Hurry on over to the garage.
Aw... What a shame. Tell you what, I'll chop your head off the next time we go on a mission, okay?
There won't BE a next time!
